seoTitle: 6 Sarsfield Quay Apartments, Liffey Street West, Arbour Hill, Dublin 7
description:
**EMAIL ENQUIRIES ONLY / NO PHONE CALLS**

Doran Estates are delighted to bring this spacious three-bedroom duplex apartment overlooking the River Liffey to the rental market.

Tastefully presented and in excellent condition throughout, the property benefits from generous accommodation and an abundance of natural light. The ground floor comprises a welcoming entrance hall, a bright and spacious living room with dining area, and a modern, well-equipped kitchen.
At first-floor level, there are three well-proportioned bedrooms, with the main bedroom benefiting from its own en-suite, along with a main bathroom.
The property also benefits from dedicated car parking, located behind secure electronic gates, providing an added level of convenience in this central city location.

The apartment is ideally positioned for enjoying everything Dublin city has to offer. O'Connell Street, Trinity College, The Four Courts and St Stephen's Green are all within easy reach, while Phoenix Park and the Polo Club are also accessible. Kilmainham and the surrounding area offer a wide range of amenities, including cafés, bars, restaurants and local attractions.
There are excellent transport links nearby, with multiple bus routes and the LUAS providing convenient access to the city centre and beyond. The Royal Hospital Kilmainham, Neptune Rowing Club, Trinity College Boat Club, Kilmainham Gaol, the Irish Museum of Modern Art and the Guinness Storehouse are also close by.

With its generous three-bedroom accommodation, river views, private parking and highly convenient location, this duplex apartment offers a well-connected base in the heart of Dublin.

Early viewing is highly recommended.
